clue.text: Contrasts left one girl upset in diaries about sex

indicators.note: in places the turned pieces inside the diary letters
about means the diary letters go around the word for sex

parts.note: taken as written
IT is a coy old word for sex appeal or sex

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the preceding pieces upside down, so they read bottom to top

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
a girl is a miss

explanation.surface: Someone notes the differences in diaries where a girl writes, upset, about sex.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upset' reads the pieces bottom to top. IT for sex is an old euphemism (as in 'having it'), and 'about' wraps the diary word around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Contrasts as a plural noun are differences or points of unlikeness, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Starts to order one My Little Pony grooming game

indicators.note: grooming suggests tidying and rearranging, so the gathered letters are reworked
Starts to asks for the opening letter of each of the next four words

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A child is told to begin brushing a My Little Pony toy as a game.
explanation.walkthrough: My Little Pony is a toy line of brightly coloured ponies with combable manes, hence the grooming.
explanation.definitionFit: The property-trading board game sold by Hasbro is a classic example of a game.

clue.text: Release toy in time, on the contrary

indicators.note: in would put the toy inside the time letter, but the clue then reverses that
on the contrary swaps the roles, so the time letter goes inside the toy instead

parts.note: Lego is the famous toy building-brick brand

explanation.surface: A child releases a toy just in time, or perhaps the reverse happens.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, 'toy in time' puts LEGO inside T; 'on the contrary' flips it, so T goes inside LEGO.
explanation.definitionFit: To release something is to stop holding it, the meaning of the phrasal verb used here.

clue.text: Soul singer's father cut joint at home

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title

indicators.note: cut means the final letter of the joint word is trimmed off

parts.note: the ankle is a joint of the leg
in means at home, as in staying in

explanation.surface: A soul singer's dad has hacked up some meat at home.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is' linking definition and wordplay. Aretha Franklin was the 'Queen of Soul'.
explanation.definitionFit: Aretha, the celebrated American vocalist of Respect, is the best-known performer of soul music with this surname.

clue.text: Like tart? Heavy metal band picks up two, separately

indicators.note: picks up means the band's name takes the extra letters inside it
separately means the two letters go in at different places, not side by side

parts.note: AC/DC is the Australian hard rock and heavy metal band
two is the Roman numeral II, split here into two single I letters
the second of the two single I letters from the Roman numeral II

explanation.surface: A dessert tart? No: a heavy metal band gets two new members.
explanation.walkthrough: The two I's go in separately: AC + I + D + I + C, one after each of the first C and the D.
explanation.definitionFit: Tart in the sense of sour or sharp-tasting describes something like acid, so this adjective fits.

clue.text: Mad Men's lead role — a sad performance

indicators.note: sad here means sorry or poor in state, so the letters are put in a sorry jumble

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: lead points to the leading letter of the word Men's

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A role in the TV drama Mad Men gave a disappointing performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mad' looks like the anagram signal but is fodder; 'sad' does the rearranging of MAD, M, ROLE and A.
explanation.definitionFit: An overwrought, sensational play or display is a kind of theatrical performance.

clue.text: English inventor current for Yankee inventor

indicators.note: for means one letter stands in place of another in the inventor's name

parts.note: James Dyson is the British inventor of the bagless vacuum cleaner

explanation.surface: An English inventor is swapped in for an American one, the Yankee inventor.
explanation.walkthrough: Thomas Edison was the American inventor of the phonograph; 'Yankee inventor' is also the definition's American flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Alva, creator of the light bulb and phonograph, is a famous American inventor.

clue.text: Crave mostly hot food, filling solely in way that shocks

indicators.note: filling means the pieces before it are stuffed inside the word for solely

parts.note: singly means one by one, alone, solely
to pine for is to crave

indicators.note: mostly means all but the final letter of the food word

parts.note: chilli is a hot, spicy food

explanation.surface: A craving for spicy food, with a filling made of nothing else, is a shocking diet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crave' and 'hot food' look like the definition's territory, but the definition is the last four words; 'filling' tells the first pieces to go inside the word for solely.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that sends a chill down your back is frightening, and the adverb describes acting in a terrifying manner.

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A trick by the escapologist Houdini reveals something about muscle work.
explanation.definitionFit: Isometric exercise tenses muscles without the limb moving, so the term describes a type of contraction.

clue.text: Turn out to be headless spoof

parts.note: a send-up is a spoof or parody

explanation.definitionFit: To end up somewhere is to finish or prove to be in some state, matching turn out to be.

clue.text: Sexy girl primarily on page three? It might get game birds

hot means sexy

explanation.surface: A sexy girl starring on Page Three, the famous tabloid pin-up feature, might attract attention.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sun is a British tabloid; its Page Three girls were topless models.
explanation.definitionFit: A smooth-bore gun firing pellets is what shooters use to bring down pheasant and grouse.

clue.text: 3 of wrong visits

parts.note: 3 refers to the answer at 3-down, release, and to drop something is to release it
a sin is a wrong

explanation.surface: Three of the wrong people come visiting.
explanation.walkthrough: The 3 points to the clue at 3-down, whose answer means release; drop is a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who calls by unannounced pays a casual visit, the meaning of the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Second working satellite

parts.note: mo is a short moment, a second
on means working, as a switched-on machine

explanation.definitionFit: Earth's natural companion orbiting it is the classic natural satellite.

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Judge caught in fine, small net — support for sportsmen?

parts.note: lay is slang for making love to someone
down means broken, as a computer system that is out of action

explanation.definitionFit: To lay down a track is to record it in a studio, a music industry idiom.

clue.text: Fighter backing America, Action Man initially enters endless attack

indicators.note: enters means those initials go inside the turned abbreviation
backing means the two-letter abbreviation is read in the other direction
initially asks for the first letter of each of the two toy words
endless means the final letter of the attack word is cut off

parts.note: a raid is an attack

explanation.surface: A soldier supporting America, with an Action Man figure, joins a relentless assault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns US into SU; 'initially' makes AM, which 'enters' it to give SAMU; 'endless' cuts RAID to RAI. Action Man is a British boy's action-figure toy.
explanation.definitionFit: A samurai was a member of Japan's warrior class, so a fighter by profession.

indicators.note: after puts the jumbled letters behind the reserve word

parts.note: a sub is a reserve player or substitute

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: Subbuteo is a British tabletoy football game played by flicking small figures.
explanation.definitionFit: The flick-to-kick tabletop football game is a long-running British game.

clue.text: About ace tips, they're practical

parts.note: re means about, concerning

to list is to tip or lean, as a ship lists

explanation.definitionFit: Pragmatic people who face facts squarely are described as down-to-earth and practical.

indicators.note: round means the jumbled letters wrap around the bend letter

parts.note: taken as written
a U-bend is a bend, giving U

explanation.walkthrough: Rampant Rabbit is a well-known brand of vibrator, so the surface is about a sex toy, but the definition is just 'toy'. The anagram output is RBIKSCUB, wrapped round U.

explanation.walkthrough: 'Shaper of body' looks like the whole definition, but 'body' gives CORPSE in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A tightly laced undergarment is worn to mould the figure, so it is a shaper.
